rules: EDIT, DO NOT REDESIGN. Exact HD source is authoritative.
Use the C150-accepted six-element source-effect removal mask and transparent CLEAN_PLATE.
Restore preserve-original LAN source pixels exactly; render only approved Korean wording for the other four physical elements.
Use exact readable-space candidate_safe_bbox values with at least the accepted 2px source inset; measure final effect-inclusive Hangul bbox before encoding.
No flattened raster resize; adjust font size/placement and rerender.
Restore raw FLIP_Y orientation before DDS encoding; reuse the exact 128-byte source DDS header/channel masks/mipmap policy.
Fail if any changed pixel/alpha escapes allowed source regions or if preserve-source LAN pixels change.
